The '''''Talon''''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it patrolled the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]] prior to the destruction of that system in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].
